standard: OWASP Top 10 / OWASP Secure Headers + Mozilla Web Security Guidelines + RFC 9116 (security.txt)
note: Externally-observable web-security posture of a public domain. Fully deterministic: every check is decided by code (evaluate.mjs) from collected HTTP/TLS evidence. decision_mode is 'auto' for all checks.

checks.title: Valid certificate and modern TLS (>=1.2)
checks.obligation: Personal/sensitive data in transit must be protected by a valid, trusted certificate and a modern TLS version.
checks.pass_criteria: Trusted, non-expired cert; TLS 1.2 or 1.3 negotiated.

checks.title: HTTP redirects to HTTPS and HSTS is set
checks.obligation: Plain HTTP must redirect to HTTPS and HSTS must enforce encrypted transport.

checks.title: No mixed content on the landing page
checks.obligation: An HTTPS page must not load active resources over plain HTTP.
fail_indicators: http:// script/style/iframe on an https page

checks.title: Content-Security-Policy present and not trivially unsafe
checks.obligation: A CSP should restrict sources to mitigate XSS/injection.
checks.pass_criteria: CSP present without unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval or wildcard default-src.

checks.title: Anti-clickjacking (X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors)
checks.obligation: Framing must be restricted to prevent clickjacking.

checks.title: Referrer-Policy restricts referrer leakage
checks.obligation: Limit referrer information sent to third parties.

checks.title: Cookies set Secure + HttpOnly + SameSite
checks.obligation: Session/identifier cookies must be protected against theft and CSRF.
checks.pass_criteria: All Set-Cookie carry Secure, HttpOnly and a SameSite policy.

checks.title: No exposed VCS metadata (/.git)
checks.obligation: Version-control metadata must not be web-reachable.

checks.title: No exposed environment/secret files
checks.obligation: Secret/config files must not be web-reachable.
checks.pass_criteria: /.env, /config and common dumps are not served.
fail_indicators: /.env or backup dump returns 200 with content

checks.title: No directory listing / common backup files
checks.obligation: Autoindex and stray backups expose internals.
checks.pass_criteria: No autoindex page; no reachable backup.zip/.sql/.bak.

checks.title: No verbose version disclosure in headers
checks.obligation: Server/framework versions should not be advertised.
checks.pass_criteria: No version numbers in Server / X-Powered-By / X-AspNet-Version.

checks.title: No insecure CORS (wildcard origin with credentials)
checks.obligation: CORS must not reflect arbitrary origins while allowing credentials.
checks.pass_criteria: No ACAO:* combined with Allow-Credentials:true; no blind origin reflection.
fail_indicators: ACAO reflects the request Origin + Allow-Credentials:true

checks.title: Third-party scripts use Subresource Integrity
checks.obligation: Cross-origin scripts should carry an integrity hash to prevent tampering.
checks.pass_criteria: Cross-origin <script>/<link> carry integrity attributes (or none are loaded).
fail_indicators: cross-origin scripts with no integrity attribute
